Dear Miss Yonge	
[I](/person/939) quite hope to write to you about the [Bethlehem](/topic/177) this week. I have the duplicates, but have not got time to read them at a sitting as I meant.
Will you kindly send the Cawnpore [notice](/book/59) to me. [Mr Trevelyan](/person/1943) has just been in. He was much gratified by your estimate of his book.[^1] For long your books and name have been familiar and dear in their family.

Yours ever faithfully
A. Macmillan


[^1]: CMY had written a review for [Macmillan\'s Magazine](/periodical/78) of George Otto Trevelyan\'s book on the massacre at Cawnpore during the [[other:]Indian Mutiny].
